note: Candidates for eval/run.py. Each changes one thing from '7b' so differences can be attributed. 'why' says what it tests, not what is expected to win.

candidates.name: lanczos
candidates.why: conventional resize: the floor every model must clearly beat

candidates.name: 7b
candidates.why: current defaults: 7B fp16, batch <= 45 balanced per shot, overlap 3, lab colour

candidates.name: 7b-wavelet
candidates.why: lab histogram-matches colour per batch; wavelet keeps the source's low frequencies per pixel

candidates.name: 7b-nocolor
candidates.why: the model's own colours, to see what correction changes

candidates.name: 7b-ov9
candidates.why: overlap 3 crossfades over one frame; 9 over three, ~17% more frames to compute

candidates.name: 7b-b81-ov9
candidates.why: longer temporal context, fewer seams; check GPU memory

candidates.name: 7b-prepend4
candidates.why: mirrored lead-in so a shot's first frames get context

candidates.name: 7b-unbalanced
candidates.why: isolates the balanced-batch change (upstream's short last batch)

candidates.name: 7b-noise
candidates.why: slight input noise, sometimes used on heavily compressed sources

candidates.name: legacy
candidates.why: the pipeline before this branch (git worktree add ../SojUpScale-legacy d9715b5), 4-GPU split
